digest.component_or_area: reconciler rich-text cutover and baseline echo suppression
propositions: State-based echo suppression compares current Jira value against last-synced baseline (ADR 0026) rather than identity-encoded round-trip to handle lossy codecs where decode(encode(x)) != x

Cloud and DC cutover route send paths through rich codecs (markdown↔ADF for Cloud; wiki rendering for DC) with two distinct compares: emit-side compares plain inbound-decoded remote; baseline-side normalizes local through normalize_outbound to match decode(baseline_wire)

Post-push GET observes looping via an inline change-gated 8-byte rich_sha hash stored in binding records; at threshold (2 consecutive identical wires) ONE GET refreshes baseline as synced_fields overlay via merge_baseline, preserving sole-writer invariant of _advance_baselines
Concurrent both-sides body edits keep rebar's value (local-wins, unchanged a713 behavior) and raise outbound-field-conflict alert; inbound description remains additive

Markdown extra (marklas + mistune) is optional lazy-imported inside three function bodies with ImportError routed to plain-text fallback; cutover flag (reconciler.rich_text_cutover, defaults OFF) gates both send paths and degrades to plain wire when extra absent or flag off
Jira-authored constructs (panel/mention/date) survive later rebar pass under origin-gating: updates fire only when local != baseline, so non-rebar edits are suppressed across passes
